Connect your phone

  1. Get a working PhoneUse device. Sign into your provider apps yourself.
  2. Run the included local server with your PhoneUse and model API credentials. Open its printed localhost URL on this Mac.
  3. Enter the exact trip or basket. Check my apps runs one provider at a time.
  4. Review screenshots and confirm basket matching before trusting a food recommendation.

The hosted preview supports manual quotes, screenshots and JSON import. Live collection runs in the supplied local backend, not this static hosted preview.
